question: If I put a notification at the top of the docs and someone closes it, will they see it again if I change the message? Also, can I add clickable links and formatting like bold text in the notification?
ground_truth: Configure an announcement banner in your docs.yml file with a message field that supports both Markdown and HTML formatting, allowing you to include links, bold text, and other formatting for your migration warnings. The banner appears at the top of your docs site, making it impossible to miss. The dismissal mechanism works intelligently: after a user dismisses the banner, it stays dismissed for that user. However, when you update the announcement content (such as announcing your next release), the banner automatically reappears for all users, including those who dismissed the previous version. This ensures time-sensitive messages reach everyone without repeatedly showing the same message. You can also customize the banner's appearance using custom CSS to match your branding or increase visibility.

metadata.cited_context: An announcement banner is a great way to draw attention to new features and product launches. When configured, the announcement bar appears at the top of your docs site. After the user dismisses the bar, it will reappear the next time you update the announcement. Markdown and HTML is supported in the announcement message. You can include links, images, and other formatting. Custom CSS can be used to customize the style of the announcement.

correctness: The answer must mention configuring the announcement banner in the `docs.yml` file.
The answer should mention that Markdown and HTML is supported in the announcement message.
The answer should indicate that the announcement banner will reappear the next time you update the announcement.
